title: Research Assistant
dek: Assist with basic tasks related to GNSS, PNT and Earth Remote Sensing, including collecting data, RINEX processing, RTKLIB.
body: This opportunity is excellent for high school / university students with interests in PNT and navigation. We are seeking people who are able to collect data and edit papers.
You may work in PNT and GNSS, or Atmospheric Science. Your work will be agreed with a contract and you will be credited appropriately.
perks: Credited appropriately (can be publication mention), and recommendations provided..
Learn the in's and out's of the PNT industry,such as data collection and RTKLIB.
If you contribute the work appropriate for co-authorship, it will be guaranteed without doubt.
requirements: Basic RTKLIB, Python and knowledge in GNSSLogger / use of receivers.
Precise and clear communication skills and ability to work remotely.
Ethical behaviour that follows the guidelines highlighted in potential offers.
fitIf: If you love PNT, or want to dive into it.
If you are knowledgable or trying to learn more about GNSS.
preferred: Python, C++, RTKLIB, SQL, Data Processing.
Prior experience is not required but will boost the application. Includes classes and internships.
engagementNote: Funding is not provided. This is unpaid and therefore consent will be properly obtained.
